## Execution tips

- Consider gripping solid sidewalls on both sides of the stapler's middle across its width, opening slightly wider than that section. Try to contact the lower base with the pads to avoid gripping only the movable cover and opening the stapler.
- Before closing, confirm that the fingers are on opposite sides of the stapler rather than pressing on top. During a slight test lift, check whether the base also leaves the table to judge whether the grasp is reliable.
- The stapler is long. Leave clearance at both ends during transport rather than dragging it along the coffee-box wall. Rotate in open space to reduce sweeping collisions with the box and black ornament behind.
- During placement, let the base contact the table fully before releasing, then withdraw upward where possible. Avoid dragging the stapler with the fingertips and changing its spacing or front-back position relative to the coffee box.
